name: D.
text: The first night I called the hotline, I didn't think anyone would pick up. They did, and I had a bed by 10pm. That one call changed everything.

name: R.
text: I lost my wallet and everything in it. Getting my ID back took about a month, but once I had it, doors started opening.

name: T.
text: I made my resume at the library. My third application turned into an interview, and I got the job.

name: M.
text: I saved a little from every paycheck. Eight months later I got my own keys. I still keep them on the same keychain.
